Theorem
[No local collapsing using scalar curvature] Source: chow-et-al-ricci-flow-part-iv:page-0061 1. ch28:28.6\group Singularity Models

For a Ricci flow on a closed manifold, fixed $T<\infty $ and $\rho >0$, there is $\kappa =\kappa (n,g(0),T,\rho )>0$ such that \[ R\le r_0^{-2}\text{ on }B_{g(t_0)}(x_0,r_0),\quad r_0<\rho \implies \frac{\Vol B_{g(t_0)}(x_0,r)}{r^n}\ge \kappa \quad (0<r\le r_0). \]
